parts.title: Part 1 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.

parts.title: Part 2 · Listening
parts.instr: Listen to your teacher’s questions. Choose the correct answer (a, b or c).

opts.a: transporting and storing things like vegetables

parts.title: Part 3 · Gap fill
parts.instr: Write ONE word in each gap.

items.q: I tried ____ vain to persuade Geoff that Sonia was no good for him.
The security ____ at the airport meant that our flight got cancelled. I was so annoyed.
I called Anne immediately after my accident but, strangely, when I told her what had happened, she just ____ out laughing!
Chris: “May I use the torch on your phone for a second, Megan?” Megan: “By all ____ , Chris. Here you are.”
If you expect me to ____ a blind eye to what you’ve just done, you must be mad!
Please ensure ____ it to the church on time.
How can they hope to govern effectively if they don’t discuss urgent matters ____ a daily basis?
Jan was sentenced ____ two years in prison for something that isn’t even a crime in our country!
Justin realized that, by ____ out the order his commanding officer had just given him, he’d be committing murder.
How can you be surprised? Of course you ____ the sack! You poured coffee over your boss!
They weren’t offering him much money, so he decided it wasn’t really worth ____ taking on the work.
When Luca saw the police come in, he made straight ____ the exit, but they managed to catch him.
Coming back home from the party on your own is completely out of the ____ , Tom. I’ll come to fetch you.
Kim is a very sensible person except when it ____ to relationships!
I can’t believe you trusted Charles when he joined the company. I saw ____ him immediately.

parts.title: Part 5 · Error correction
parts.instr: Correct the mistake in each sentence. You can add one word, take out one word, or change one word. Type the whole corrected sentence.

items.text: The students could hardly wait to make into practice all the skills they had picked up on the course they had just completed.
Harry was making no friends at college, but it never occurred in him that it might be his fault.
All staff members are entitled for a 25% discount on company products.
Put these biscuits on the table now, and I’ll keep the rest as reserve for when Dad gets home later.
Please dispose away all your rubbish carefully, using the bins provided.
I’d have been late if you hadn’t taken me a lift this morning.
Nothing on this lunch menu really appeals for me. Could we try somewhere else?
All the documents seem to be at order, so, as long as you’re happy, you can put your signature on the bottom line there.
The first few years of Flo’s marriage were a struggle. She was living abroad, in a country that was under war with her own.
It’s actually a six-bedroom house, but almost none of the building is visible from the road. In fact, after first sight, most people think it’s a tiny cottage.

parts.text: Tom’s so creative. How does he come up with all his musical ideas? As the train drew into the station, I felt a rush of excitement about the journey ahead. A guitar consists of two main parts: the body and the neck. Dan broke his arm climbing at the weekend. Needless to say, he won’t be playing football with us this evening. How are you getting on at your new job, Geoff? Good morning, Mike. What did you get up to over the weekend? Anything interesting? The company is closing ten of its stores in Europe, but no staff will be made redundant.

teacher.1: What do clothes do when they get smaller in the wash?
teacher.2: What do we call a very quick look at something?
teacher.3: What do you wear to stop people from recognizing you?
teacher.4: What are the three forms of “wind”?
teacher.5: What do you do if your foot catches on something and you fall?
teacher.6: Where do we go when we leave a boat and arrive on land?
teacher.7: What does a boat do if it has no power and nobody is steering?
teacher.8: What do we drop from a boat to stop it moving?
teacher.9: What do we use sacks for?
teacher.10: What can we see only when there are gaps in the clouds?

7: Nothing on this lunch menu really appeals to me. Could we try somewhere else?
8: All the documents seem to be in order, so, as long as you’re happy, you can put your signature on the bottom line there.
9: The first few years of Flo’s marriage were a struggle. She was living abroad, in a country that was at war with her own.
10: It’s actually a six-bedroom house, but almost none of the building is visible from the road. In fact, at first sight, most people think it’s a tiny cottage.
